controls.label: Shape
controls.qualification: A sphere of the published radius, lit by TIC 178172313; the neutral gray is a display convention, not a measured colour.
controls.notes: No image or colour of TIC 178172313 b is published: the sphere has its measured size, and the gray marks an unresolved surface. The lighting is its own star's, at the measured orbit. The gray takes the colour of tic-178172313's light, as its colour dataset measures it.

charts.alt: The orbits of TIC 178172313's planets in this map from above, to scale, with TIC 178172313 b highlighted and the direction to Earth down. Each orbit is the one the app draws, from the published period, a/R*, eccentricity and argument of periastron; the star is a marker, not to scale.

TIC 178172313 b crossing its star, as TESS recorded it: 2 sectors (30, 31) of the SPOC pipeline's 2-minute light curves of TIC 178172313, each transit divided by a straight line fitted to the light either side and folded onto the orbit the app draws, moved 4 minutes earlier to where TESS measures the dip, inside the published ephemeris's 3-sigma uncertainty of 96 minutes at these dates, then averaged in 9-minute bins. Error bars are each bin's standard error.
